outcomes.text: Make functions run at the right time
Work with arrays and data from a file

questions.prompt: What happens when this code runs?

choices.text: A TypeError: you can't reassign a const

questions.explain: A const can't be given a new value with =. Use let for a value that changes.

questions.prompt: What is wrong with this line?

choices.text: Nothing. It runs check on each click
It runs check once, straight away, not on a click

questions.explain: check() calls the function now. Pass the function itself: addEventListener('click', check). React's onClick works the same way.
map makes a new array from what the function returns for each item. React uses it to draw lists.

questions.prompt: What is the value of result?
questions.explain: JSON.parse turns the text into an object. Its score property is the number 5.

questions.prompt: fetch('questions.json') gets a 404 because the file is missing. What does fetch do?

choices.text: It throws an error straight away
It still resolves. You must check response.ok yourself
It tries again until the file appears

questions.explain: fetch only rejects when the request fails, such as a network error. A 404 still resolves, so check response.ok.
